title: Privacy notice — Baruch
description: Baruch privacy policy and personal data handling.
heading: Privacy notice

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: This notice describes how Baruch will handle personal data when the quote form is active. In the current MVP, this site does not collect or store data through online forms.

sections.heading: Data to be collected (future)
sections.body: Name, email, phone, experience of interest and message. This data will only be used to follow up on information or quote requests.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access, correction or deletion of your data by contacting us by email. We will respond within a reasonable timeframe in accordance with applicable law.

sections.heading: Privacy contact
sections.body: For questions about this notice, write to hello@baruch.example (placeholder).
